correctness.rationale: Collision fibers give exact good subtraction; a count of at most six exceptions gives additive interpolation for all \(q\ge7\); \(q=5\) has no exceptional ratios; \(q\le4\) are explicit. Executed verifier exhaustively enumerates pointed bijections for \(q\le9\) and checks examples through \(q=16\); finite checks are not a universal proof.

value.rationale: An exact automorphism classification across all finite fields for a canonical nonadditive permutation yields a structural infinite family and sharp socle transition. It converts a live qualitative conjectural framework into a complete computable family, with a nontrivial fiber-rigidity theorem that reconstructs field arithmetic from a magma. This is not a mere known-small-rank table.
